Package index

Fitting a model

The usual entry point. fit_semihawkes() runs the whole pipeline from raw sf points to a converged fit; the stages it composes are exported individually below, so a single step can be inspected without running the full EM loop.

fit_semihawkes()
Fit a semi-parametric self-exciting (Hawkes) point process by EM
em_step()
Single EM step: E-step responsibilities + M-step update of A, mu, and all non-parametric background/triggering components
summary(<semihawkes_fit>) print(<summary.semihawkes_fit>)
Summarize a fitted semi-parametric Hawkes model
plot(<semihawkes_fit>)
Plot method for a fitted semihawkes_fit object

Data preparation

Validating and reshaping event data, and the two per-event quantities the background estimator needs: an adaptive kernel bandwidth and a Monte Carlo edge-correction integral.

prepare_events()
Prepare a spatio-temporal event dataset for semi-parametric Hawkes fitting
adaptive_bandwidth()
Adaptive (nearest-neighbour) spatial bandwidth for each event
add_adaptive_bandwidth()
Add an adaptive bandwidth column to a semihawkes_events object
bg_integral()
Monte Carlo integral of each event's isotropic Gaussian kernel over the study region
add_bg_integral()
Add the background-kernel edge-correction integral to a semihawkes_events object

Background intensity

The non-parametric components of the background term — a long-term trend, calendar-month and day-of-week periodicities, and a spatial surface.

temporal_base_trend()
Long-term trend temporal base value
temporal_base_weekly()
Weekly non-parametric temporal base value
temporal_base_monthly()
Monthly non-parametric temporal base value
background_spatial()
Non-parametric spatial background surface
background_intensity()
Combine temporal and spatial background components into the background intensity shape (without the scalar mu parameter)

Triggering (self-exciting) component

Initial parametric guesses for the temporal and spatial triggering kernels, their evaluation over events and the study domain, and their non-parametric re-estimation from EM responsibility weights.

trigger_temporal_init()
Initial (parametric) temporal triggering-function guess
trigger_spatial_init()
Initial (parametric) spatial triggering-function guess
trigger_evaluate()
Evaluate self-exciting (triggering) contributions at events and over the study domain
trigger_pairs()
Build the (i, j) triggering-pair index for re-estimation
trigger_pair_weights()
EM responsibility weights for triggering pairs
trigger_spatial_marks()
Cache per-event spatial edge-correction marks
trigger_edge_correction()
Per-event temporal/spatial edge-correction factors for trigger re-estimation
trigger_reestimate_temporal()
Re-estimate the temporal triggering kernel from EM responsibility weights
trigger_reestimate_spatial()
Re-estimate the spatial triggering kernel from EM responsibility weights

Branching structure and uncertainty quantification

Stochastic declustering: Monte Carlo sampling of the branching structure (which events are background vs. triggered, and by whom) from a fitted model, for quantifying uncertainty in any downstream summary.

sample_branching()
Sample one realization of the branching structure via UQ
sample_branching_multi()
Draw multiple independent realizations of the branching structure
check_branching_weights()
Check consistency of background probabilities and excitation weights
summarize_branching_samples()
Summarize an ensemble of branching-structure samples

Diagnostics and visualization

Grid-based intensity snapshots, spatial maps, and animations built from a fitted model.

plot_event_summary()
Plot a summary of a spatio-temporal event data set
background_trigger_grid()
Evaluate background and triggering intensity on a spatial grid over time
integrate_intensity_period()
Integrate gridded intensity over one time period
background_to_grid_sf()
Convert a semihawkes background grid to an sf polygon grid
crop_background_spatial()
Crop a semihawkes spatial background to its study-area sf polygon
plot_intensity_snapshot()
Plot one gridded intensity snapshot
animate_intensity_snapshots()
Animate previously evaluated intensity snapshots
inspect_spatial_grid()
Inspect a candidate spatial grid

Simulated example data

A small simulated dataset with known generating values, so that fitted components have real structure to recover and something to be checked against.

sim_events
Simulated crime events for an example city
sim_region
Study-area boundary for the example city

Milwaukee example data

Geocoded drug-related deaths in Milwaukee County from 2020 onward, supplied with a polygonal observation window for illustrating semi-parametric spatio-temporal Hawkes modelling.

milwaukee
Drug-related deaths in Milwaukee County
milwaukee_county
Milwaukee County observation window

Simulated crime example data

Events simulated from a semi-parametric Hawkes model fitted to transformed intentional homicide records from Guayaquil, Ecuador, with a geomasked observation window, for illustrating semi-parametric spatio-temporal Hawkes modelling.

crimes
Synthetic crime-like events from a fitted Hawkes model
crimes_region
Geomasked spatial window for the crime example

Numerical primitives

Simpson’s-rule integration, weighted histograms and Gaussian kernel smoothing, ported from Zhuang & Mateu (2019). Note that the smoothers differ in their boundary handling and are not interchangeable — see ker.smooth.fft().

simpson()
Simpson's rule integral of an equally-spaced function
simpson.2D()
Simpson's rule double integral of an equally-spaced function
hist(<weighted>) hist(<weighted.1D>)
Weighted 1D histogram
hist(<weighted.2D>)
Weighted 2D histogram
ker.smooth.conv()
1D Gaussian kernel smoothing by direct convolution, with reflected boundaries
ker.smooth.fft() ker.smooth.1D.fft()
1D Gaussian kernel smoothing by FFT, with periodic boundaries
ker.smooth.2D.fft()
2D Gaussian kernel smoothing by FFT, with reflected boundaries

Goodness-of-fit diagnostics

Tools for assessing fitted semi-parametric Hawkes models using temporal and spatial residual diagnostics.

gof_time_transform()
Time-transformed goodness-of-fit diagnostic
gof_spatial_residuals()
Spatial raw residuals for a fitted model
gof_period_residuals()
Spatial residuals by time period
intensity_at_times()
Total model intensity integrated over space
plot(<semihawkes_gof_time>)
Plot a time-transformed goodness-of-fit diagnostic
plot(<semihawkes_gof_spatial>)
Plot spatial residuals
plot(<semihawkes_gof_period>)
Plot period-wise spatial residuals
